# opnsense_zerotier_settings (Resource)

ZeroTier settings (**VPN ▸ ZeroTier ▸ Settings**, plugin `os-zerotier`). Networks are `opnsense_zerotier_network` resources. This is a singleton: import it with the ID `zerotier_settings` before managing it. Attributes left unset keep their current value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_zerotier_settings.this
  id = "zerotier_settings"
}

resource "opnsense_zerotier_settings" "this" {
  enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_access_token` (String, Sensitive) Access Token used for the Zerotier API service.
- `enabled` (Boolean) This will activate the Zerotier service.
- `localconf` (String) A JSON document containing configuration options that apply to the local node.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `zerotier_settings`.
